subject.scope: structural operational readiness for scientific and governance evolution

invariant_definition.equation: Omega = Identity tensor Relation tensor Provenance tensor Measure tensor Rights tensor State tensor Evidence
invariant_definition.interpretation: Operational Omega is the preservation of identity, relation, provenance, measure, rights, state and evidence across transformations.
invariant_definition.operator_boundary: tensor denotes architectural articulation, not physical multiplication

hard_invariants.statement: No promoted result exists without origin, run, commit, method and dataset lineage.
No scientific claim is promoted without evidence and explicit claim-boundary review.
No TOKEN_VAZIO is silently converted into certainty, falsehood or supersession.
No material transformation occurs without an auditable record of input, action and output.
hard_invariants.next_action: Extend receipts to non-CI and historical transformations.

hard_invariants.statement: No historical evidence is erased; supersession and invalidation remain append-only and justified.
No critical execution advances without logs, checksums, status and a reproducible audit receipt.
No technical objective overrides authorization, dignity, privacy, authorship, license or safety.
hard_invariants.next_action: Link dataset rights manifests to every run lineage.

directions.question: Can every promoted result be traced to one run, commit, dataset lineage and immutable artifact?
directions.gap: Historical results have not all been migrated into field-level run manifests.
directions.urgent_action: Materialize manifests for historical cosmology runs and build a canonical append-only run ledger.

directions.question: Do model names, epistemic states, units and claim boundaries retain one meaning across code and documents?
directions.gap: RLL model-family names and version boundaries are not yet enforced by one machine-readable registry.
directions.urgent_action: Create a canonical RLL model-family registry and validate references from reports and manifests.

directions.question: Are units, domains, transformations, normalizations and boundary conditions explicit and mutually compatible?
directions.gap: No single dimensional-invariant registry covers the scientific outputs and transformations of the full RLL pipeline.
directions.urgent_action: Create a dimensional contract for observables, parameters, domains, units and allowed transformations.

directions.question: Does the runtime execute what the canonical architecture declares and emit auditable receipts?
directions.gap: Resume and verified artifact-reuse controls are still incomplete even though structural execution mapping is verified.
directions.urgent_action: Add start_from, stop_after and hash-verified artifact reuse without weakening the deterministic gate.

directions.question: Can the system preserve history, distinguish lineages and explain every supersession or invalidation?
directions.gap: The precedence policy exists structurally, but historical state transitions are not yet materialized in an append-only ledger.
directions.urgent_action: Implement field-level precedence resolution and a state-transition ledger preserving invalidated evidence.

directions.question: Are authorization, license, privacy, authorship, retention and security boundaries attached to each input and action?
directions.gap: Dataset-level rights and license manifests are not uniformly linked to scientific run provenance.
directions.urgent_action: Require rights, license, access date, privacy class and consent boundary in every dataset lineage entry.

directions.question: Does every hypothesis define an observable, baseline, uncertainty, falsifier and objective exit condition?
directions.gap: Growth, out-of-sample validation and full CMB scope remain open falsification routes.
directions.urgent_action: Materialize falsifier contracts for f_sigma8, holdout validation and explicitly versioned CMB backend levels.

omega_metrics.metric_boundary: routing convention; not physical geometry, probability, evidence or scientific validation

urgent_conditions.statement: Materialize field-level provenance for every canonical scientific result.
exit_criteria: Historical canonical runs have valid manifests.
Every promoted result resolves to one artifact SHA-256.

urgent_conditions.statement: Define machine-readable RLL model families and semantic version boundaries.
exit_criteria: Each report names one registered model family.

urgent_conditions.statement: Create the dimensional and domain invariant registry for the full scientific pipeline.
exit_criteria: Every observable declares unit and domain.
Every transformation declares compatible input and output dimensions.

urgent_conditions.statement: Add resumable execution with verified artifact reuse and deterministic boundaries.
exit_criteria: Reused artifacts match code, data, parameter and environment hashes.

urgent_conditions.statement: Materialize append-only temporal state transitions and field-level precedence.
exit_criteria: Invalidated results remain preserved with reasons.

urgent_conditions.statement: Attach rights, license, privacy and authorization metadata to all dataset lineages.
exit_criteria: Every dataset has source, license and access date.
Sensitive or unknown rights fail closed.

urgent_conditions.statement: Complete falsifier contracts for growth, holdout validation and CMB scope.
exit_criteria: Each hypothesis has observable, baseline, uncertainty and falsifier.
Each route emits a versioned evidence artifact or TOKEN_VAZIO.

next_gate: Implement U1, U3, U5, U6 and U7 before any stronger operational or scientific promotion.
